verses.1:
In that day you will say:
 “O LORD, I will praise You.
 Although You were angry with me,
 Your anger has turned away,
 and You have comforted me.
verses.2:
Surely God is my salvation;
 I will trust and not be afraid.
 For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song,
 and He also has become my salvation.”
verses.3: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,
verses.5:
Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things.
 Let this be known in all the earth.
verses.6:
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion,
 for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
